# Supertext Plugin Health (bundled copy)

Built JavaScript of the TypeScript part of [Supertext Plugin Health](https://github.com/Supertext/Commando-Center-Supertext-Translation/tree/main/plugin-health) (`plugin-health/typescript`), version 0.4.0, commit `d9d8e1827bc81c60bd557b2a5153ed6d5990cd5d`. `package.json` makes it the `supertext-plugin-health` devDependency that the extension build bundles into `dist/`.

Don't edit these files: fix it in Commando-Center-Supertext-Translation/plugin-health, then run `scripts/vendor-plugin-health.sh`.
